method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Constructs common director market/laboratory/contracts/pregame/hint/app-loadout views. Black-market/contracts visibility follows exact dvar/UI gates; pregame list filters showPregameButton==true and uses DirectorPregameButtons. Focus changes refresh hint state, focused hintText updates content, and app readiness/lobby changes validate state. It installs close, calls optional PostLoadFunc, sets _preGameType public and returns self. Purchase, contracts and companion services remain unavailable/provider gaps.
